newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin 1-yr bond average yield hits 17.8%.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin 1-yr bond average yield hits 17.8%.

text.p: The average yield in a Slovak Finance Ministry auction of one-year state bonds on Tuesday rose to 17.8 percent from 16.812 percent in the previous auction on July 8, the central bank said in a statement.
The ministry accepted bids worth 2.420 billion crowns out of total demand of 3.01 billion crowns.
The ministry does not set an amount on offer at state securities auctions, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.

It uses T-bills and state bonds as the main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 17.790 billion crowns as of July 8, from 7.177 billion crowns in the January- May period of this year.
